病人监护仪.summaryEn: Bedside multiparameter monitor for continuous assessment of adult, pediatric, and neonatal patients.
病人监护仪.applicationEn: Intensive care units, operating rooms, recovery areas, emergency departments, and general wards.
病人监护仪.specificationsEn: ePM 12 configuration with a 12.1-inch touchscreen; supports routine bedside monitoring and configurable physiological parameters.
病人监护仪.packagingEn: Standard export packaging; probes, cables, and accessories are configured to project requirements.

输液泵.summaryEn: Single-channel volumetric infusion pump for controlled delivery of fluids and medications.
输液泵.applicationEn: Operating rooms, intensive care units, emergency departments, and general wards.
输液泵.specificationsEn: BeneFusion VP5ex configuration; precise flow control with air-in-line alarm and infusion-pressure monitoring.
输液泵.packagingEn: Standard export packaging; power cord and mounting accessories are configured to project requirements.

心电图机.summaryEn: Digital electrocardiograph for resting 12-lead ECG acquisition, display, analysis, and reporting.
心电图机.applicationEn: Cardiology departments, outpatient clinics, emergency departments, and inpatient wards.
心电图机.specificationsEn: BeneHeart R300 12-lead configuration with digital signal acquisition and interference-reduction functions.
心电图机.packagingEn: Standard export packaging; patient cable, limb electrodes, chest electrodes, and recording accessories are configured to project requirements.

超声系统.summaryEn: Portable color Doppler ultrasound platform for point-of-care and general diagnostic imaging.
超声系统.applicationEn: Obstetrics and gynecology, radiology, emergency care, critical care, and general ultrasound examinations.
超声系统.specificationsEn: TE9S configuration; supports color Doppler imaging and configurable transducers for clinical applications.
超声系统.packagingEn: Standard export packaging; transducers, trolley, and accessories are configured to project requirements.

呼吸机.summaryEn: Invasive ventilator for respiratory support in critical-care and emergency settings.
呼吸机.applicationEn: Intensive care units, emergency departments, transport support, and acute-care wards.
呼吸机.specificationsEn: SV300 configuration for adult and pediatric ventilation; ventilation modes and accessories are configured to clinical requirements.
呼吸机.packagingEn: Standard export packaging; breathing circuit, humidification, and mounting accessories are configured to project requirements.

除颤仪.summaryEn: Automated external defibrillator with guided operation for emergency response to sudden cardiac arrest.
除颤仪.applicationEn: Emergency departments, outpatient areas, ambulances, public-access locations, and first-response services.
除颤仪.specificationsEn: BeneHeart C2 AED configuration with voice and visual prompts; electrode and battery options depend on the destination market.
除颤仪.packagingEn: Standard export packaging; battery, electrode pads, carrying case, and accessories are configured to project requirements.

制氧机.summaryEn: Medical oxygen concentrator for continuous supplemental oxygen delivery.
制氧机.applicationEn: Hospital wards, clinics, long-term care facilities, and home oxygen therapy.
制氧机.specificationsEn: Model 8F-10W; nominal flow capacity up to 10 L/min with an integrated nebulization function.
制氧机.packagingEn: Standard export packaging; humidifier bottle, tubing, and patient accessories are configured to project requirements.

麻醉机.summaryEn: Anesthesia workstation for delivery and monitoring of inhalational anesthesia during surgery.
麻醉机.applicationEn: Operating rooms and surgical centers performing procedures under general anesthesia.
麻醉机.specificationsEn: A4C configuration with an integrated breathing system and anesthetic vaporizer compatibility; final configuration depends on clinical requirements.
麻醉机.packagingEn: Standard export packaging; breathing system, vaporizers, gas hoses, and monitoring accessories are configured to project requirements.

病床.summaryEn: Electric hospital bed with configurable positioning functions for inpatient and long-term care.
病床.applicationEn: General wards, rehabilitation units, long-term care facilities, and elderly-care settings.
病床.specificationsEn: Model CA-67; multiple electric position adjustments with side rails designed to support patient safety.
病床.packagingEn: Standard export packaging; mattress, side rails, castors, and optional accessories are configured to project requirements.

吸引器.summaryEn: Mobile electric suction apparatus for removal of blood, secretions, and other fluids during clinical procedures.
吸引器.applicationEn: Operating rooms, wards, outpatient clinics, emergency departments, and treatment rooms.
吸引器.specificationsEn: Model DFX-23C III; adjustable high-vacuum suction with overflow protection.
吸引器.packagingEn: Standard export packaging; collection bottles, tubing, filters, and accessories are configured to project requirements.
